serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
This guy has grabbed my arm out of nowhere! 
You: C-could you release my arm?!
What’s wrong with this dude?! People are starting to stare at us…
???: Call them.
You: Huh?
???: You said someone is waiting for you, right?
???: Call them and I will let you go. 
You: Just let me go dude, I didn’t do anything wrong!
???: You won’t call them, right? I knew there was something fishy about you!
???: Listen everyone! I found a fed! He’s a fed!
You: W-what are you talking about?!
I need to run! Even more people are coming this way!
